note: Each session receives only 'Path: <absolute start folder in its fixture copy>' and the brief text. The start folder is also the session's working directory. No answer, home name, or hint is in a brief.

briefs.text: The notification digest design was approved last week and implementation starts tomorrow; nothing is built yet. Write the design document: what the digest contains, when it is sent, and what it never includes.
Draft a proposal to cache the board's rendered output between runs. It is only an idea for the team to review; nothing is decided or built.
We chose JSON Lines over SQLite for run logs. Record the decision, the reason, and what we gave up, so nobody reopens it by accident.
Make a cheat sheet of the commands to restart a failed ticket: each command and one line on when to use it.
Write the numbered steps a maintainer follows to rotate the model table: edit the table, run the checks, record the change.
Record today's benchmark: 12 tasks, 10 passed, cost $4.20, run on 2026-10-06 against the lane scripts. Finding: cost fell 18 percent against last month.

A teammate drew board-flow.svg, a flow diagram of the board. Add the file so documents can embed it. Its content is: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="160" height="40"><rect width="160" height="40" fill="none" stroke="black"/><text x="8" y="24">board flow</text></svg>
The guide on resuming a stopped run is out of date: automatic resume replaced it in release 0.21. Retire it but keep it for history, and say what replaced it.

Here are loose notes from a call, none of them sorted: 'timeouts feel short; maybe cache the board; ask about licences; try the new model for planning'. File them so they are not lost until someone sorts them.
Ticket T-0007 finished and its independent verifier passed it. Write the verifier's result: verdict pass, three checks run (unit tests, lint, link check), no findings.
Write the steps a new maintainer follows to add a role to the runner: create the role file, wire it into the table, run its check. Numbered.
While closing ticket T-0007 we agreed to revisit the retry timeout default later, but not as a ticket of its own. Write that follow-up down so it is not lost.

pilot.text: Record that the nightly job runs at 02:00 UTC and takes about 20 minutes.
